tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the brands (websites) tracked in this Howseen account, with their id, name and domain. Call this first when the account may have several brands.

tools.name: get_visibility
tools.description: Headline AI visibility of a brand: % of AI answers that name it, share of voice vs competitors, average position, sentiment, per engine, plus the trend over the period (one point per scan).

tools.name: list_prompts
tools.description: The buyer questions (prompts) tracked for a brand, with per-prompt visibility, share of voice, position, which engines name the brand, and which brands and domains are cited.

tools.name: get_competitors
tools.description: Compare the brand with its competitors in AI answers: visibility %, share of voice, average position and sentiment, overall and per engine.

tools.name: get_top_sources
tools.description: The domains and URLs AI engines cite most when answering the brand's buyer questions, overall and per engine. Use it to find where the brand should get listed or mentioned.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.description: Change the brand's profile, writing rules or Autopilot, or add / remove a brand. operation: add_brand = add a brand within the plan's sites (url, name); remove_brand = PERMANENTLY delete a brand and its data (brand, confirm_name); instructions = set or append writing rules, binding on every article;

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account, get_visibility, get_actions, manage_tracking, update_settings · Public sink: get_visibility, get_content, get_traffic, publish_article, create_share_report · Destructive: get_actions, manage_tracking, manage_articles, update_settings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account, get_visibility, get_actions, manage_tracking, update_settings · Public sink: get_visibility, get_content, get_traffic, publish_article, create_share_report · Destructive: get_actions, manage_tracking, manage_articles, update_settings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_brands" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_visibility" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Headline AI visibility of a brand: % of AI answers that name it, share of voice vs competitors, average position, sentiment, per engine, plus the trend over the period (one point per scan)." → after: "How often ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode name the brand. view: overview = visibility %, share of voice, position, per engine, trend; competitors = the brand against its competitors, per engine; changes = what moved since the previous scan (or since a date) and why; sent"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
